rows: 2026-11-25 — On the named iPhone the prepared device identity and revised NeetCode assertion passed all fifteen LeetCode cases in 201.4 s. The unchanged screen recorder retained every case. A lower-resolution idb stream produced corrupted frames and was discarded. The hosted iOS sample recorded 771.4 s for LeetCode and 1,633.2 s for Tamil with a missing keyboard hit, a developer overlay, and disabled app accessibility after Unicode entry. Target these measured failures during the next qualification.
